Introduction

Shin Hyo-Seob, better known by the stage name Crush, is a South Korean R&B and hip-hop singer and producer under P Nation. He was one half of the duo Masterpiece and is a member of the project hip-hop crew FANXYCHILD. He officially debuted as a soloist on April 1, 2014, with the single "Sometimes".
